cond_0001.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is seeking a Research Technician. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Pre-Employment Screening
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

cond_0024.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is looking for a Research Technician. This is a good fit for someone with some prior laboratory experience who wants to build their skill set and see several projects through to completion. You will work closely and regularly with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
This role assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0024.responsibilities:
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment. Stays in regular contact with laboratory staff and investigators throughout ongoing projects.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0024.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate regularly with laboratory staff and investigators.

cond_0047.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is seeking a Research Technician. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0047.responsibilities:
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0047.requirements:
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate effectively with laboratory staff and investigators.
Strong ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Solid understanding of computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree required; up to 1 year of demonstrated expertise in a laboratory setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience totaling 4 years.

This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0119.responsibilities:
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0119.requirements:
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate effectively with laboratory staff and investigators.
Strong ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Solid understanding of computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree required; up to 1 year of demonstrated expertise in a laboratory setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience totaling 4 years.
Pre-Employment Screening
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.
cond_0119.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0119.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.
cond_0119.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

cond_0145.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is seeking a Research Technician. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
cond_0145.responsibilities:
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0145.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Pre-Employment Screening
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0156.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0156.requirements:
Ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators — this is something that can develop with practice and support.
Ability to keep complete and organized records/reports.
Familiarity with computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience, and around 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Pre-Employment Screening
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.
cond_0156.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0156.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

This is a good fit for someone with some prior laboratory experience who wants to build their skill set and contribute to several projects through to completion. The person in this role will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to carry out experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke, as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
This role supports the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0180.responsibilities:
Assist with research studies, experiments, and assays, including collecting data, preparing solutions, and helping set up and maintain equipment.
Perform data entry and help maintain data files on research.
Prepare tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Follow established safety procedures and help maintain required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Work with the team to ensure lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Contribute to general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0180.requirements:
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.
cond_0180.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

cond_0221.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is seeking a Research Technician. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke. Most people become stronger in this kind of lab work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0221.responsibilities:
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0221.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Pre-Employment Screening
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.

The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is seeking a Research Technician. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.

Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0244.requirements:
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.

cond_0256.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care at [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Technician. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke. People who do well in this role often find they can get a feel for the lab's methods and experimental logic fairly quickly.
cond_0256.responsibilities:
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0256.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Pre-Employment Screening
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.
cond_0256.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

This is a good fit for someone with some prior laboratory experience who wants to build their skill set and see several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will coordinate with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0277.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0277.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records and reports.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently and report clearly to laboratory staff and investigators.

cond_0441.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is looking for a Research Technician. This is a good fit for someone with some prior laboratory experience who wants to build their skill set and see several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to carry out experiments and analyze data together.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
This role supports the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0441.responsibilities:
Assist with research studies, experiments, and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions, and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Perform data entry and help maintain data files on research.
Prepare tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc., coordinating with team members as needed.
Follow established safety procedures and help maintain required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Work with the team to ensure lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Support general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0441.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Pre-Employment Screening
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.

cond_0466.intro:
The Albertson Lab within the section of Neurocritical Care is seeking a Research Technician. This is ideal for someone with some prior laboratory experience who is interested in building their skill set and seeing several projects through to completion. Qualified applicants will coordinate with our multidisciplinary team and Dr. Albertson to perform experiments and analyze data.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
Assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0466.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Performs data entry and maintains data files on research.
Prepares tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Complies with established safety procedures and maintains required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensures lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0466.requirements:
Ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators on task-specific matters.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.

cond_0593.intro:
The [Company name masked] within the section of Neurocritical Care is seeking a Research Technician. This role is well suited for someone with some prior laboratory experience who wants to build their skill set and see several projects through to completion. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team and lead your contributions to experiments and data analysis.
Our lab uses animal models and cell culture to better understand the pathophysiology of ischemic stroke. We are particularly interested in the mechanisms of recovery and neuroplasticity after stroke as well as the relationship between aging and stroke. We use a variety of techniques including molecular and cell biology, animal behavior, stereotax, viral transduction, microscopy, neuron tracing, and histology to address our questions. We combine these experiments with data from stroke patients to pursue a long-term goal of meaningfully improving the lives of individuals who have suffered from an ischemic stroke.
cond_0593.responsibilities:
Execute technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
Conduct research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment.
Own data entry and maintain data files on research.
Prepare tissue cultures, reagents, probe tests, etc.
Ensure compliance with established safety procedures and maintain required documentation on laboratory and specimen conditions.
Ensure lab conditions and equipment are properly cleaned and maintained in accordance with established procedures.
Manage general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Working Conditions
This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0593.requirements:
Demonstrated ability to work independently and communicate with laboratory staff and investigators.
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
